rules.unlisted_policy: The rules leave additions to the organizers. Listed upstream examples or functional aliases do not establish permission for this run.
rules.cleanup_ambiguity: rm is absent from the explicit external-command list but appears in both official cleanup examples; record this discrepancy instead of inventing organizer approval or automatically declaring an accepted entry illegal.
rules.elf_scope: ELF entries cannot rely on external programs. The two public ELF representatives and bounded process-exec checks are reported in elf-comparison.json.
